text: The Patriots limp into Sunday's 1 PM ET home opener against the Steelers looking to secure their first win of 2026 after a disappointing Week 1, with Drake Maye and company facing a rolling Pittsburgh squad in what figures to be a crucial early-season chess match at Gillette Stadium—though New England has some good news on the injury front, as running back TreVeyon Henderson declared himself "ready to go" after missing the opener with an ankle injury, even as the team grapples with the significant loss of A.J. Brown, who suffered a high ankle sprain in Week 1 that will sideline him for the next four weeks, forcing other receivers to step into expanded roles. Experts are weighing in with their picks and analysis of this pivotal matchup, and meanwhile Patriots owner Robert Kraft made headlines this week by removing rapper Macklemore as an opening act for Ed Sheeran's Gillette Stadium shows, citing his "history of antisemitic rhetoric and imagery that we believe has been deeply offensive and hurtful to the Jewish community."
